behavior: A beat is accepted only when input valid and input ready are both high.
Masked lanes contribute signed zero to all three outputs.
A first beat selects the three input biases as accumulation bases.
A non-first beat selects the retained three-channel accumulators.
A normal last beat publishes one three-channel result.
Any signed 32-bit overflow publishes fault and never publishes success.
Result valid, data, and fault remain stable while result ready is low.
Reset cancels in-flight work and clears retained accumulators and output state.
